subject: Partner-led discovery: schedule technical deep dive / CloudBridge integration
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@cloudbridge.com>
To: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, camila_reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Kumar <priya.k@gsipartners.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up & next steps from today's partner discovery — technical deep dive

Hi Marissa and Camila,

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation and excited about the potential to list CloudBridge on Redwood's marketplace and the GSI integration path. As discussed, we'd like to schedule a partner-led technical deep dive / demo with our engineering and product team + your runtime folks to align on integration patterns and SSO/SCIM requirements.

Quick recap of what we heard on our side:
- Primary use case: marketplace listing + managed connector to push customer provisioning events to CloudBridge.
- Security priority: SOC2 evidence and ability to run in a VPC for enterprise customers.
- Success metric: go-live in pilot with 2 customers within 8–10 weeks.

Proposed next-step slots (PST):
- Wed Mar 24: 10:00–11:00 or 14:00–15:00
- Thu Mar 25: 11:00–12:00

Attendees from our side: Alex Johnson (CloudBridge, Platform PM), Priya Kumar (GSI Partner Owner). If those times work, we can send a calendar invite; otherwise let me know alternatives.

I've attached a draft Integration Scope doc with the endpoints we discussed. Please flag anything missing. Also — what internal folks from Redwood should join the deep dive (runtime/solutions/eng)?

Thanks,
Alex

--
Alex Johnson
Head of Platform Integrations, CloudBridge
alex.johnson@cloudbridge.com | +1 (415) 555-0182
Attachment: CloudBridge_Integration_Scope.pdf
